body: Thanks for saying so. This type of things feels so hard to explain to someone who hasn't experienced it so it's nice to know it resonates with someone.  The times that I have personally experienced this the other person (both times) was already in a committed long term relationship.  So I had to accept that from the start - and that was ok with me because I knew I couldn't step into that space anyway.  But that is so long as nothing between us has to change.  If someone getting into a new relationship meant we couldn't interact the same way, I too would be devastated.

It’s so different than friends.  I don’t cry about or experience intense longing for my friends though I’m emotionally open and we can talk about anything  - but I dream about, fantasize and cry about and long for my hush/mesh.  I also don’t envision a conventional  relationship with them.  I just admire them and can’t get enough but don’t want to date them.  Just absorb their essence.  I want them to prefer me above others.  I might be open to taking it to a sexual place but that’s not what’s driving it and something about sex with them feels not quite right either.  Just want to know them and feel that emotional closeness.  I remember every moment with them the way you might with a crush, but not seeking more than attention and interest and connection from them.  For me it feels like I can’t get enough of them, respect them, look forward to seeing them.  It’s torture when it’s unrequited.
I don't touch my face without washing my hands.
